verses.original: לְמַחְלְק֖וֹת לְשֹׁעֲרִ֑ים לַקָּרְחִ֕ים מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־ קֹרֵ֖א מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י אָסָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: lə·maḥ·lə·qō·wṯ lə·šō·‘ă·rîm laq·qā·rə·ḥîm mə·še·lem·yā·hū ḇen- qō·rê min- bə·nê ’ā·sāp̄
verses.literal: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers From the Korahites Meshelemiah son of Kore one of the sons of Asaph

verses.original: וְלִמְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֖הוּ בָּנִ֑ים זְכַרְיָ֤הוּ הַבְּכוֹר֙ יְדִֽיעֲאֵ֣ל הַשֵּׁנִ֔י זְבַדְיָ֙הוּ֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יַתְנִיאֵ֖ל הָרְבִיעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lim·še·lem·yā·hū bā·nîm zə·ḵar·yā·hū hab·bə·ḵō·wr yə·ḏî·‘ă·’êl haš·šê·nî zə·ḇaḏ·yā·hū haš·šə·lî·šî yaṯ·nî·’êl hā·rə·ḇî·‘î
verses.literal: Meshelemiah had sons Zechariah the firstborn Jediael the second Zebadiah the third Jathniel the fourth

verses.original: עֵילָ֤ם הַחֲמִישִׁי֙ יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַ֖י הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·lām ha·ḥă·mî·šî yə·hō·w·ḥā·nān haš·šiš·šî ’el·yə·hō·w·‘ê·nay haš·šə·ḇî·‘î
verses.literal: Elam the fifth Jehohanan the sixth and Eliehoenai the seventh

verses.original: וּלְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם בָּנִ֑ים שְׁמַֽעְיָ֤ה הַבְּכוֹר֙ יְהוֹזָבָ֣ד הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יוֹאָ֤ח הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ וְשָׂכָ֣ר הָרְבִיעִ֔י וּנְתַנְאֵ֖ל הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm bā·nîm šə·ma‘·yāh hab·bə·ḵō·wr yə·hō·w·zā·ḇāḏ haš·šê·nî yō·w·’āḥ haš·šə·li·šî wə·śā·ḵār hā·rə·ḇî·‘î ū·nə·ṯan·’êl ha·ḥă·mî·šî
verses.literal: And Obed-edom also had sons Shemaiah the firstborn Jehozabad the second Joah the third Sachar the fourth Nethanel the fifth

verses.original: עַמִּיאֵ֤ל הַשִּׁשִּׁי֙ יִשָׂשכָ֣ר הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י פְּעֻלְּתַ֖י הַשְּׁמִינִ֑י כִּ֥י בֵרֲכ֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mî·’êl haš·šiš·šî yi·śā·š·ḵār haš·šə·ḇî·‘î pə·‘ul·lə·ṯay haš·šə·mî·nî kî ḇê·ră·ḵōw ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Ammiel the sixth Issachar the seventh and Peullethai the eighth For God had blessed Obed-edom

verses.original: וְלִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֤ה בְנוֹ֙ נוֹלַ֣ד בָּנִ֔ים הַמִּמְשָׁלִ֖ים לְבֵ֣ית אֲבִיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ גִבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·liš·ma‘·yāh ḇə·nōw nō·w·laḏ bā·nîm ham·mim·šā·lîm lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇî·hem kî- ḡib·bō·w·rê ḥa·yil hêm·māh
verses.literal: Also to his son Shemaiah were born sons who ruled over their families . . . because they were strong capable men

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁמַֽעְיָ֗ה עָ֠תְנִי וּרְפָאֵ֨ל וְעוֹבֵ֧ד אֶלְזָבָ֛ד אֶחָ֖יו בְּנֵי־ חָ֑יִל אֱלִיה֖וּ וּסְמַכְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê šə·ma‘·yāh ‘ā·ṯə·nî ū·rə·p̄ā·’êl wə·‘ō·w·ḇêḏ ’el·zā·ḇāḏ ’e·ḥāw bə·nê- ḥā·yil ’ĕ·lî·hū ū·sə·maḵ·yā·hū
verses.literal: Shemaiah’s sons were Othni Rephael Obed and Elzabad his brothers were Elihu and Semachiah also capable men

verses.original: כָּל־ אֵ֜לֶּה מִבְּנֵ֣י׀ עֹבֵ֣ד אֱדֹ֗ם הֵ֤מָּה וּבְנֵיהֶם֙ וַאֲחֵיהֶ֔ם אִֽישׁ־ חַ֥יִל בַּכֹּ֖חַ לַעֲבֹדָ֑ה שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנַ֖יִם לְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’êl·leh mib·bə·nê ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm hêm·māh ū·ḇə·nê·hem wa·’ă·ḥê·hem ’îš- ḥa·yil bak·kō·aḥ la·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh šiš·šîm ū·šə·na·yim lə·‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm
verses.literal: All these were descendants of Obed-edom they and their sons and brothers were capable men with strength to do the work 62 . . . in all from Obed-edom

verses.original: וְלִמְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֗הוּ בָּנִ֧ים וְאַחִ֛ים בְּנֵי־ חָ֖יִל שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lim·še·lem·yā·hū bā·nîm wə·’a·ḥîm bə·nê- ḥā·yil šə·mō·w·nāh ‘ā·śār
verses.literal: Meshelemiah also had sons and brothers who were capable men 18 in all . . .

verses.original: וּלְחֹסָ֥ה מִן־ בְּנֵי־ מְרָרִ֖י בָּנִ֑ים שִׁמְרִ֤י הָרֹאשׁ֙ כִּ֣י לֹא־ הָיָ֣ה בְכ֔וֹר וַיְשִׂימֵ֥הוּ אָבִ֖יהוּ לְרֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḥō·sāh min- bə·nê- mə·rā·rî bā·nîm šim·rî hā·rōš kî lō- hā·yāh ḇə·ḵō·wr way·śî·mê·hū ’ā·ḇî·hū lə·rōš
verses.literal: Hosah the Merarite . . . also had sons Shimri the first although he was not the firstborn his father had appointed him as the first

verses.original: חִלְקִיָּ֤הוּ הַשֵּׁנִי֙ טְבַלְיָ֣הוּ הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֔י זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ הָרְבִעִ֑י כָּל־ בָּנִ֧ים וְאַחִ֛ים לְחֹסָ֖ה שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: ḥil·qî·yā·hū haš·šê·nî ṭə·ḇal·yā·hū haš·šə·li·šî zə·ḵar·yā·hū hā·rə·ḇi·‘î kāl- bā·nîm wə·’a·ḥîm lə·ḥō·sāh šə·lō·šāh ‘ā·śār
verses.literal: Hilkiah the second Tebaliah the third and Zechariah the fourth The sons and brothers of Hosah numbered 13 . . . in all

verses.original: לְ֠אֵלֶּה מַחְלְק֨וֹת הַשֹּֽׁעֲרִ֜ים לְרָאשֵׁ֧י הַגְּבָרִ֛ים מִשְׁמָר֖וֹת לְעֻמַּ֣ת אֲחֵיהֶ֑ם לְשָׁרֵ֖ת בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·’êl·leh maḥ·lə·qō·wṯ haš·šō·‘ă·rîm lə·rā·šê hag·gə·ḇā·rîm miš·mā·rō·wṯ lə·‘um·maṯ ’ă·ḥê·hem lə·šā·rêṯ bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: These divisions of the gatekeepers through their chief men had duties for ministering in the house of the LORD just as their relatives did

verses.original: וַיַּפִּ֨ילוּ גוֹרָל֜וֹת כַּקָּטֹ֧ן כַּגָּד֛וֹל לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָ֖ם לְשַׁ֥עַר וָשָֽׁעַר׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yap·pî·lū ḡō·w·rā·lō·wṯ kaq·qā·ṭōn kag·gā·ḏō·wl lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām lə·ša·‘ar wā·šā·‘ar
verses.literal: They cast lots for each gate . . . according to their families . . . young and old alike

verses.original: וַיִּפֹּ֧ל הַגּוֹרָ֛ל מִזְרָ֖חָה לְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֑הוּ וּזְכַרְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֜וֹ יוֹעֵ֣ץ׀ בְּשֶׂ֗כֶל הִפִּ֙ילוּ֙ גּֽוֹרָל֔וֹת וַיֵּצֵ֥א גוֹרָל֖וֹ צָפֽוֹנָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yip·pōl hag·gō·w·rāl miz·rā·ḥāh lə·še·lem·yā·hū ū·zə·ḵar·yā·hū ḇə·nōw yō·w·‘êṣ bə·śe·ḵel hip·pî·lū gō·w·rā·lō·wṯ way·yê·ṣê ḡō·w·rā·lōw ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh
verses.literal: The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah Then lots were cast for his son Zechariah a wise counselor and the lot for the North Gate fell to him

verses.original: לְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם נֶ֑גְבָּה וּלְבָנָ֖יו בֵּ֥ית הָאֲסֻפִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lə·‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm neḡ·bāh ū·lə·ḇā·nāw bêṯ hā·’ă·sup·pîm
verses.literal: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-edom and the lot for the storehouses . . . to his sons

verses.original: לְשֻׁפִּ֤ים וּלְחֹסָה֙ לַֽמַּעֲרָ֔ב עִ֚ם שַׁ֣עַר שַׁלֶּ֔כֶת בַּֽמְסִלָּ֖ה הָעוֹלָ֑ה מִשְׁמָ֖ר לְעֻמַּ֥ת מִשְׁמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: lə·šup·pîm ū·lə·ḥō·sāh lam·ma·‘ă·rāḇ ‘im ša·‘ar šal·le·ḵeṯ bam·sil·lāh hā·‘ō·w·lāh miš·mār lə·‘um·maṯ miš·mār
verses.literal: The lots for the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway fell to Shuppim and Hosah There were guards stationed at every watch

verses.original: לַמִּזְרָח֮ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם שִׁשָּׁה֒ לַצָּפ֤וֹנָה לַיּוֹם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לַנֶּ֥גְבָּה לַיּ֖וֹם אַרְבָּעָ֑ה וְלָאֲסֻפִּ֖ים שְׁנַ֥יִם שְׁנָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: lam·miz·rāḥ hal·wî·yim šiš·šāh laṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh lay·yō·wm ’ar·bā·‘āh lan·neḡ·bāh lay·yō·wm ’ar·bā·‘āh wə·lā·’ă·sup·pîm šə·na·yim šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: Each day there were six Levites on the east four on the north four on the south and two pairs . . . at the storehouse

verses.original: לַפַּרְבָּ֖ר לַֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב אַרְבָּעָה֙ לַֽמְסִלָּ֔ה שְׁנַ֖יִם לַפַּרְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: lap·par·bār lam·ma·‘ă·rāḇ ’ar·bā·‘āh lam·sil·lāh šə·na·yim lap·par·bār
verses.literal: As for the court on the west there were four at the highway and two at the court

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה מַחְלְקוֹת֙ הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים לִבְנֵ֥י הַקָּרְחִ֖י וְלִבְנֵ֥י מְרָרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh maḥ·lə·qō·wṯ haš·šō·‘ă·rîm liḇ·nê haq·qā·rə·ḥî wə·liḇ·nê mə·rā·rî
verses.literal: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari

verses.original: וְֽהַלְוִיִּ֑ם אֲחִיָּ֗ה עַל־ אֽוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּלְאֹֽצְר֖וֹת הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hal·wî·yim ’ă·ḥî·yāh ‘al- ’ō·wṣ·rō·wṯ bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·lə·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ haq·qo·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: Now their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries of the dedicated things

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י לַ֠עְדָּן בְּנֵ֨י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֜י לְלַעְדָּ֗ן רָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְלַעְדָּ֥ן הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י יְחִיאֵלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê la‘·dān bə·nê hag·gê·rə·šun·nî lə·la‘·dān rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lə·la‘·dān hag·gê·rə·šun·nî yə·ḥî·’ê·lî
verses.literal: From the descendants of Ladan who were Gershonites through Ladan and heads of the families of Ladan the Gershonite were Jehieli

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י יְחִֽיאֵלִ֑י זֵתָם֙ וְיוֹאֵ֣ל אָחִ֔יו עַל־ אֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê yə·ḥî·’ê·lî zê·ṯām wə·yō·w·’êl ’ā·ḥîw ‘al- ’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: the sons of Jehieli Zetham and his brother Joel They were in charge of the treasuries of the house of the LORD

verses.original: לַֽעַמְרָמִי֙ לַיִּצְהָרִ֔י לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִ֖י לָֽעָזִּיאֵלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: la·‘am·rā·mî lay·yiṣ·hā·rî la·ḥeḇ·rō·w·nî lā·‘āz·zî·’ê·lî
verses.literal: From the Amramites the Izharites the Hebronites and the Uzzielites

verses.original: וּשְׁבֻאֵל֙ בֶּן־ גֵּרְשׁ֣וֹם בֶּן־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה נָגִ֖יד עַל־ הָאֹצָרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·ḇu·’êl ben- gê·rə·šō·wm ben- mō·šeh nā·ḡîḏ ‘al- hā·’ō·ṣā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: Shebuel a descendant of Gershom son of Moses was the officer in charge of the treasuries

verses.original: וְאֶחָ֖יו לֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֑זֶר רְחַבְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֜וֹ וִֽישַׁעְיָ֤הוּ בְנוֹ֙ וְיֹרָ֣ם בְּנ֔וֹ וְזִכְרִ֥י בְנ֖וֹ וּשְׁלֹמוֹת בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’e·ḥāw le·’ĕ·lî·‘e·zer rə·ḥaḇ·yā·hū ḇə·nōw wî·ša‘·yā·hū ḇə·nōw wə·yō·rām bə·nōw wə·ziḵ·rî ḇə·nōw ū·šə·lō·mōṯ bə·nōw
verses.literal: His relatives through Eliezer included Rehabiah his son Jeshaiah his son Joram his son Zichri his son and Shelomith his son

verses.original: ה֧וּא שְׁלֹמ֣וֹת וְאֶחָ֗יו עַ֣ל כָּל־ אֹצְר֤וֹת הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִקְדִּ֜ישׁ דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְרָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְשָׂרֵֽי־ הָאֲלָפִ֥ים וְהַמֵּא֖וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֥י הַצָּבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: hū šə·lō·mō·wṯ wə·’e·ḥāw ‘al kāl- ’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ haq·qo·ḏā·šîm ’ă·šer hiq·dîš dā·wîḏ ham·me·leḵ wə·rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lə·śā·rê- hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·ham·mê·’ō·wṯ wə·śā·rê haṣ·ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: This Shelomith and his brothers were in charge of all the treasuries . . . for the things dedicated by King David by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and of hundreds and by the army commanders

verses.original: מִן־ הַמִּלְחָמ֥וֹת וּמִן־ הַשָּׁלָ֖ל הִקְדִּ֑ישׁוּ לְחַזֵּ֖ק לְבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: min- ham·mil·ḥā·mō·wṯ ū·min- haš·šā·lāl hiq·dî·šū lə·ḥaz·zêq lə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: They had dedicated some of the plunder from their battles to the repair of the house of the LORD

verses.original: וְכֹ֨ל הַֽהִקְדִּ֜ישׁ שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל הָרֹאֶה֙ וְשָׁא֣וּל בֶּן־ קִ֔ישׁ וְאַבְנֵ֣ר בֶּן־ נֵ֔ר וְיוֹאָ֖ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל הַמַּקְדִּ֔ישׁ עַ֥ל יַד־ שְׁלֹמִ֖ית וְאֶחָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ha·hiq·dîš šə·mū·’êl hā·rō·’eh wə·šā·’ūl ben- qîš wə·’aḇ·nêr ben- nêr wə·yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·rū·yāh kōl ham·maq·dîš ‘al yaḏ- šə·lō·mîṯ wə·’e·ḥāw
verses.literal: Everything that had been dedicated by Samuel the seer Saul son of Kish Abner son of Ner and Joab son of Zeruiah along with everything else that was dedicated was under the care of Shelomith and his brothers

verses.original: לַיִּצְהָרִ֞י כְּנַנְיָ֣הוּ וּבָנָ֗יו לַמְּלָאכָ֤ה הַחִֽיצוֹנָה֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים וּלְשֹׁפְטִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lay·yiṣ·hā·rî kə·nan·yā·hū ū·ḇā·nāw lam·mə·lā·ḵāh ha·ḥî·ṣō·w·nāh ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl lə·šō·ṭə·rîm ū·lə·šō·p̄ə·ṭîm
verses.literal: From the Izharites Chenaniah and his sons had the outside duties as officers and judges over Israel

verses.original: לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִ֡י חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ֩ וְאֶחָ֨יו בְּנֵי־ חַ֜יִל אֶ֣לֶף וּשְׁבַע־ מֵא֗וֹת עַ֚ל פְּקֻדַּ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מַעְרָ֑בָה לְכֹל֙ מְלֶ֣אכֶת יְהוָ֔ה וְלַעֲבֹדַ֖ת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: la·ḥeḇ·rō·w·nî ḥă·šaḇ·yā·hū wə·’e·ḥāw bə·nê- ḥa·yil ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·ḇa‘- mê·’ō·wṯ ‘al pə·qud·daṯ yiś·rā·’êl mê·‘ê·ḇer lay·yar·dên ma‘·rā·ḇāh lə·ḵōl mə·le·ḵeṯ Yah·weh wə·la·‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: From the Hebronites Hashabiah and his relatives 1,700 . . . . . . . . . capable men had charge of the affairs of Israel . . . west of the Jordan for all the work of the LORD and for the service of the king

verses.original: לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִי֙ יְרִיָּ֣ה הָרֹ֔אשׁ לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִ֥י לְתֹלְדֹתָ֖יו לְאָב֑וֹת בִּשְׁנַ֨ת הָֽאַרְבָּעִ֜ים לְמַלְכ֤וּת דָּוִיד֙ נִדְרָ֔שׁוּ וַיִּמָּצֵ֥א בָהֶ֛ם גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל בְּיַעְזֵ֥יר גִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: la·ḥeḇ·rō·w·nî yə·rî·yāh hā·rōš la·ḥeḇ·rō·w·nî lə·ṯō·lə·ḏō·ṯāw lə·’ā·ḇō·wṯ biš·naṯ hā·’ar·bā·‘îm lə·mal·ḵūṯ dā·wîḏ niḏ·rā·šū way·yim·mā·ṣê ḇā·hem gib·bō·w·rê ḥa·yil bə·ya‘·zêr gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: As for the Hebronites Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites according to the genealogies of his ancestors In the fortieth year of David’s reign the records were searched and strong capable men were found among the Hebronites at Jazer in Gilead

verses.original: וְאֶחָ֣יו בְּנֵי־ חַ֗יִל אַלְפַּ֛יִם וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֑וֹת וַיַּפְקִידֵ֞ם דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ עַל־ הָראוּבֵנִ֤י וְהַגָּדִי֙ וַחֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשִּׁ֔י לְכָל־ דְּבַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וּדְבַ֥ר הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’e·ḥāw bə·nê- ḥa·yil ’al·pa·yim ū·šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ way·yap̄·qî·ḏêm dā·wîḏ ham·me·leḵ ‘al- hā·r·’ū·ḇê·nî wə·hag·gā·ḏî wa·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ ham·naš·šî lə·ḵāl də·ḇar hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·ḏə·ḇar ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Among Jerijah’s relatives there were 2,700 . . . . . . capable men who were heads of families King David appointed them over the Reubenites the Gadites and the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king
